analysis:
In his 7 June 2021 address Modi said states had demanded decentralisation of vaccine work, leading the Centre to give them 25% of procurement from May 1. Alt News reviewed state and opposition statements before 19 April 2021.

It found most states, including Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Rajasthan, Punjab, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, asked the Centre to procure and allocate. Odisha's 30 March letter asked that vaccines be available in the open market for those who can afford them. Maharashtra's letter seeking to procure came 8 May, after the policy was announced.

The Supreme Court had called the policy 'arbitrary and irrational' days before the speech.
notes: Alt News did not report a formal government response to its article. Rating 'Misleading' is Alt News's own. The Hindi wording of the quote was not retrieved; English as quoted by Alt News.
